findings.body:
**Bound the fixing-commit check to `target..tip`.**

Line 53 accepts any commit reachable from `tip`. That includes commits older than `row['target']`, and those commits cannot have fixed a finding raised against `target`. The `history` field at Line 41 lists only `target..tip`, so the judge sees only that range. A hallucinated or mis-picked commit from before `target` still passes this gate if it touches the finding path. The `fixed` verdict then records `already-fixed` with an unrelated commit and removes the finding from the pending set. The `superseded` verdict has no path-touch check, so it is fully exposed.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-            if commit not in repo.git('rev-list', tip).decode().splitlines():
+            if commit not in repo.git('rev-list', row['target'] + '..' + tip).decode().splitlines():
                 raise ValueError('commit not ancestor')
```
</details>

This also shrinks the `rev-list` output.
findings.title: Bound the fixing-commit check to `target..tip`.

findings.body:
**A git or lookup failure in `context()` aborts the whole phase.**

The `try` catches only `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` and `OSError`. `repo.git` raises on failure by default. Line 32 passes `check=False`, and Line 58 catches `CalledProcessError`.

`context()` can raise these exceptions for a single bad row:
- `CalledProcessError` from `git log target..tip` at Line 41 when `target` is no longer resolvable.
- `KeyError` from `repo.entries(row['target'])[finding['path']]` at Line 27.
- `ledger.IntegrityError` from `ledger.intervals`.

An uncaught exception skips the `plans` loop at Lines 149-156. This discards the deterministic `duplicate` and `superseded` plans already built, and it skips the delivery loop. Critical rows sort first (Line 126), so the same row fails on every tick and blocks the backlog.

This conflicts with I9: "Fleet runs collect all results and never bail mid-fleet." Convert a per-row context failure into a `needs-human` plan and continue.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
         try:
             packed = context(repo, row, tip)
+        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, KeyError, ledger.IntegrityError) as exc:
+            plans.append((row, 'needs-human', 'finding context unavailable: ' + type(exc).__name__, {}))
+            continue
+        try:
             remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
```
</details>

The `unjudged` count at Line 168 then includes these rows. Adjust that count if it must stay accurate.
findings.title: A git or lookup failure in `context()` aborts the whole phase.
